intended_allowed_use: Historical Bangladesh ingestion and authorized MVP experiments under the declared CC BY 4.0 license

permissions_basis.storage: CC BY 4.0 permits copying the licensed material
permissions_basis.ml_experimentation: CC BY 4.0 permits adaptation for any purpose, subject to its conditions and rights actually licensed
permissions_basis.redistribution: Permitted for the licensed material with attribution, license link, modification notices and no additional restrictions; full-file redistribution is not chosen for this repository
permissions_basis.automated_collection: Only the published official file download was attempted. No permission for live marketplace collection is inferred. HTTP 403 must not be bypassed.

collection_date_evidence: Original collection dates are not stated in the accessible dataset description. Publication is not collection or listing date.

normalization.mileage_unit_evidence: kilometers_run identifies kilometres; all 1209 inspected values are bare integers.

verified_unit_profile.evidence: Authors' paper https://www.mdpi.com/2078-2489/12/12/514 Table 1 explicitly defines price in taka and engine_capacity in cc. Inspected local V2 car_dataset.csv contains bare integer values. Preserve price integers as full BDT with multiplier 1 and engine integers as cc; kilometers_run specifies km. This reviewed convention applies automatically only to these exact file bytes.

review_thresholds.description: Initial review heuristics only. Values outside these ranges are retained and flagged, never silently corrected. These are not measured dataset statistics or learned market limits.

retrieval_date_basis: Date received by this local workflow; original web download date is unknown
source_verification: Operator supplies the official V2 release; matching headers do not independently prove provenance
